name: Customizable Dice- Text or Classic Dots

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable six-sided gaming die with significantly rounded corners and edges, giving it a soft, spherical-cube appearance. The faces of the die feature recessed hemispherical dimples (pips) representing numbers, such as two, three, four, and six. One of the faces is customized to display a single exclamation mark character instead of a standard dot, demonstrating the custom character engraving feature.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable six-sided gaming die in OpenSCAD that allows the user to toggle between standard dot pips and custom text characters for each face. The script must include parameters for the die width, corner rounding (using a sphere intersection), pip/character sizes, rotations, and support dual extrusion by outputting either the main die body or just the symbols.
captions.factory: The code constructs the die body in the 'die_cube' module by intersecting a cube of size 'die_width' with a sphere of radius 'die_width * 0.7' to achieve rounded corners. Each of the six faces is defined in its own module ('side1' to 'side6'), where standard pips are created using translated spheres, and custom characters are rendered using the external 'writecube' module. The 'main' module either subtracts the face symbols from the die cube (for single-color printing) or intersects them (to isolate the symbols for dual extrusion).
